result.summary: The layout is largely coherent, but several visual defects appear: truncated restaurant names without ellipsis in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, inconsistent favorite-button styling, a card thumbnail whose background style doesn't match its siblings, redundant delivery-price info, and content clipped at the right edge and behind the bottom nav.

issues.description: The third card title in 'Fastest near you' is hard-clipped ('Trattoria Piccol', '€1.90 delivery' cut at the viewport edge) with no ellipsis or fade, making it look broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis constrained to the card width, and add a gradient/peek treatment so the carousel clearly reads as horizontally scrollable.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons are inconsistent: the Tokumaru Ramen card uses a white circular button with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark/translucent circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button background, size and icon color across all cards; use one variant (e.g. translucent dark scrim with white icon) for legibility on any image.

issues.description: Duplicate information on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card: the '€0 delivery' badge on the image repeats the '€0 delivery' text in the metadata row.
issues.suggestion: Show the free-delivery badge only on the image and omit it from the meta line (or vice versa).

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail has a light grey background while the neighbouring thumbnails are dark, so the row looks visually unbalanced and its white time badge has weak contrast against the light image.
issues.suggestion: Normalize thumbnail treatment (consistent background/overlay scrim) and ensure badges keep sufficient contrast on light imagery.

issues.description: The category filter chip row is cut off mid-chip at the right edge with no visible affordance that more filters exist.
issues.suggestion: Add edge padding/fade or a partially visible chip with a scroll hint so the overflow is intentional-looking.

issues.description: The pizza card at the bottom is sliced by the bottom navigation bar with no title or metadata visible, leaving an ambiguous partial image.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the nav bar height so cards end cleanly above it.
